Got it!

Calling all Artists and Makers! It's time to join:

Calling all Artists and Makers! It's time for a reset...

After mentoring dozens of teaching artists over the last 4 years, I've seen what it really takes to get traction in  your educator business.

I know so many of you are still struggling to figure out why things feel scattered and why your wheels are always spinning.

In this workshop we'll discuss the 5 blocks that are quietly holding you back and the one simple principle that will help your business grow.

In your session, I'll walk you through:

  • Why doing more doesn't fix the problem.

  • How being pulled in too many directions is quietly slowing your growth.

  • What it actually means to work within your Zone of Genius.

  • A simple framework I call the Rule of One, and why it changes everything.

  • Walk away with clarity and a new insights for growth on your terms.

You don’t need to figure everything out in this one workshop. But you will start to see what’s holding you back and how to start moving in the direction of your Big Audacious Dreams!

Join Kellee Wynne for a FREE Strategy Workshop!

After mentoring dozens of teaching artists over the last 4 years, I've seen what it really takes to get traction in  your educator business.

I know so many of you are still struggling to figure out why things feel scattered and why your wheels are always spinning.

In this workshop we'll discuss the 5 blocks that are limiting your success and then I'll introduce a simpler way to run your business so it actually works.

In your session, I'll walk you through:

  • Why doing more doesn't fix the problem.

  • How being pulled in too many directions is quietly slowing your growth.

  • What it actually means to work within your Zone of Genius.

  • A simple framework I call the Rule of One, and why it changes everything.

  • Walk away with clarity and a new insights for growth on your terms.

You don’t need to figure everything out in this one workshop. But you will start to see what’s holding you back and how to start moving in the direction of your Big Audacious Dreams!

"Now is the time for weirdos, artists, and independent thinkers. Everything that made you an outsider in the old world has prepared you to be a leader in the new one." - James McCrae

"Now is the time for weirdos, artists, and independent thinkers. Everything that made you an outsider in the old world has prepared you to be a leader in the new one." - James McCrae

Hi! I’m Kellee Wynne: Artist, Writer and Strategy Expert for Course Creators

After more than 12 years of online business experience and mentoring some of the best known course creators, I've distilled everything I know into a sensible approach that helps Artists and Makers finally reach their financial goals without burning out.

I'm the host of the Made Remarkable™ Podcast, which explores creativity and entrepreneurship. I write a kickass newsletter called Build it with Kellee Wynne. I've hosted more than 20,000 students in my online art courses. And I wrote a book, “Mixed Media Color Workshop” published by Quarto Books, which dives into modern color theory.

I'd love to connect with you on Instagram

Hi! I’m Kellee Wynne: Artist, Writer and Strategy Expert for Course Creators

After more than 12 years of online business experience and mentoring some of the best known course creators, I've distilled everything I know into a sensible approach that helps Artists and Makers finally reach their financial goals without burning out.

I'm the host of the Made Remarkable™ Podcast, which explores creativity and entrepreneurship. I write a kickass newsletter called Build it with Kellee Wynne. I've hosted more than 20,000 students in my online art courses. And I wrote a book, “Mixed Media Color Workshop” published by Quarto Books, which dives into modern color theory.
